payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet

condition.question: Does the edited image show a frog added to the toilet, compared with the source?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED. Determine whether a frog is visibly added to the toilet scene. The small dark object already in the source bowl is not a frog. Frogs on the lid or floor establish frog presence in the scene, but do not establish placement inside the bowl.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the toilet in the input image, with a small dark object already in the bowl and no visible frog. EDITED: the same toilet scene, with frogs visible in the bowl, on the raised lid, and on the floor beside the toilet.
condition.source_quote: Put a frog in the toilet
condition.aspect: A frog is added to the toilet scene.
condition.endpoint: A frog is visibly added to the toilet scene.
condition.necessity: The request requires adding a frog; this facet checks that a frog is present in the edited scene rather than mistaking the pre-existing dark bowl object for one.
condition.zero_when: No frog is visibly added compared with the source; the pre-existing dark object alone does not count.
condition.half_when: A frog is partly visible or only weakly identifiable as an added frog, leaving its presence materially incomplete or uncertain.
condition.full_when: At least one frog is clearly visible in the edited toilet scene and was not present in the source.

requirement.text: Put a frog in the toilet
requirement.source_phrase: Put a frog in the toilet
